subject: Re: Acme Platform - proposed P1 triage window for planned maintenance
messages:
From: Tom Everett <tom@acmeplatform.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: support-team@acmeplatform.com
Date: 2027-04-22T16:12:00Z
Subject: Re: Notice of planned platform maintenance and SLA impact request

Hi Sean,

Quick heads-up from our infra team: Acme Platform is planning a rolling database migration 2027-04-30 00:00-06:00 UTC. We expect a small but non-zero chance of increased error rates and latency for some API calls during the window.

Given the business-critical nature of a subset of our workloads, we need a short-term formal exception to the standard P1 response process: specifically, acknowledgment within 15 minutes but a triage/first-action SLA of up to 60 minutes for incidents flagged as P1 that occur during that maintenance window.

Can Redwood confirm whether you can provide 24/7 covered escalation for that night (i.e., dedicated on-call or a named backup), plus an agreed escalation path to infrastructure if we see a systemic issue?

I attached our SLO exception form with context. We'd like a firm agreement by Friday 2027-04-23 to finalize our runbook.

Thanks,
Tom Everett
Head of Platform Reliability
Acme Platform

Attachment: slo-exception-form.pdf
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Everett <tom@acmeplatform.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-22T18:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Notice of planned platform maintenance and SLA impact request

Tom,

Thanks for the heads-up and for sending the form — I have it. We're fine working this as a temporary, documented exception provided we land a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that clarifies scope, compensating controls, and an on-call roster.

Proposed high-level MAP (draft):
- Exception window: 2027-04-30 00:00-06:00 UTC
- P1 handling during window: automatic 15-minute acknowledgment; target first-action (triage) 60 minutes
- Coverage: Redwood primary on-call (normal rotation) plus dedicated backup: Ben Carter (backup lead) and Laura Bennett (secondary) for the window
- Escalation ladder: backup lead -> Redwood SRE (Marcus Lin) -> Redwood infra duty manager -> joint incident bridge with Acme (if >45m unresolved)
- Telemetry: Acme to share pre- and post-maintenance baseline metrics; Redwood will enable verbose request logging and hold a shared Slack bridge during the window
- Compensation / credits: to be discussed and stated in the signed exception form

Can Ben and Laura confirm coverage availability? If yes, Tom, we can finalize the MAP and circulate the signed SLO-exception-form + DocuSign link. I also attached a working MAP doc.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Director, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference

Attachment: mutual-action-plan.md
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Tom Everett <tom@acmeplatform.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T20:14:00Z
Subject: Re: Notice of planned platform maintenance and SLA impact request

On Thu, Apr 22, 2027 at 18:03 Sean Gallagher wrote:
> Proposed high-level MAP (draft):
> - Exception window: 2027-04-30 00:00-06:00 UTC
> - P1 handling during window: automatic 15-minute acknowledgment; target first-action (triage) 60 minutes
> - Coverage: Redwood primary on-call (normal rotation) plus dedicated backup: Ben Carter (backup lead) and Laura Bennett (secondary) for the window

I'm available that night for backup lead across the full window (I can be on-call remote). A couple pragmatic asks from my side:
- Break the window into two 3-hour shifts so we don't have one person covering six straight hours (I can take 00:00-03:00 UTC, Laura can take 03:00-06:00 UTC)
- If an incident escalates to infra-level systemic failure, route to Marcus Lin (marcus.lin@redwood.ai) and page the infra duty manager immediately — don't wait for manual approval.
- I'd like a short written credit term if response times exceed the temporary target more than twice during the window.

If Acme is OK with the shift split and credit-triggers, I can confirm and update the oncall-roster.csv and be ready for the Slack bridge.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior On-call Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: oncall-roster.csv
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Everett <tom@acmeplatform.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-23T02:46:00Z
Subject: Re: Notice of planned platform maintenance and SLA impact request

Thanks — adding a couple of compliance and tooling notes before sign-off.

- For auditability, we'll capture a short post-mortem even if the window is incident-free; that will include request traces, request-id sampling, and the full bridge timeline.
- If Acme requires KMS or key-rotation-related access during the window, we need an explicit pre-approved runbook because of our change control for private deployments. Please indicate in the exception form if key operations are in-scope.
- Marissa, please confirm whether legal wants language around the temporary credit triggers that Ben proposed.

Assuming Tom confirms the shift split and notes about KMS, I think we can sign and push the DocuSign link.

Laura Bennett
Head of Platform Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Tom Everett <tom@acmeplatform.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, support-team@acmeplatform.com
Date: 2027-04-23T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Notice of planned platform maintenance and SLA impact request

Sean / team — this plan works for us. Two confirmations from Acme:
1) Shift split accepted: Acme agrees 00:00-03:00 UTC (Ben) and 03:00-06:00 UTC (Laura).
2) No key rotations planned for this maintenance; KMS ops are out-of-scope for now.

We accept the proposed escalation ladder (backup lead -> Marcus Lin -> infra duty manager -> joint bridge). We also agree to the post-mortem requirement. Regarding credits: Acme is comfortable with a capped credit if response targets are missed more than twice; leave the exact language to your legal/Marissa for DocuSign.

Please send the DocuSign link and we'll sign the exception form today. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Tom
Tom Everett
Head of Platform Reliability
Acme Platform

Attachment: filled-slo-exception-form.pdf
